listings.title: Dawn ferry to Gull Spit
listings.summary: Leaves slip 4 at 06:10. Last walk-on tickets sold at the kiosk, not onboard. Bicycles in the bow rack only.

listings.title: Whiting and lemon sole on the slab
listings.summary: Brought in before first light. Sole goes first; ask Marta for the smaller fish if you are frying at home.

listings.title: Spring tide this evening
listings.summary: High water 21:14. The outer steps will cover. Do not leave dinghies on the lower rings overnight.

listings.title: Navy wool cap, brass pin
listings.summary: Found on the west pontoon after the squall. Pin is a small mackerel. Claim at the harbor office with a description.

listings.title: Caulking help needed on Lark
listings.summary: Wooden sloop on hard standing. Two days of seam work, tools provided. Pay at the end of each day. Speak to Owen.

listings.title: Fiddle night in the net loft
listings.summary: Friday from 20:00. Bring a chair if you have one. No tickets; hat by the door for the players.

listings.title: Cove cleanup after the weekend swell
listings.summary: Meet at the lookout, 09:00 Saturday. Gloves and sacks on site. Dogs welcome if they stay off the nests.

listings.title: Kiln bakery: rye and fennel loaves
listings.summary: Oven opens at 08:30. Fennel sells out by 09:15. Leave a tin if you want a loaf held until noon.

listings.title: New coastal charts at the reading room
listings.summary: 2026 corrections for the inner channel. Ask at the desk; they do not leave the building.

listings.title: Visitor berth 18 free until Thursday
listings.summary: Twelve meters, shore power, water on the finger. Book at the office before 16:00 or it goes to the waiting list.

listings.title: Tabby cat, answers to Mackerel
listings.summary: White bib, nick in the left ear. Last seen near the smokehouse. Food bowl left out by the ice doors.

listings.title: Sunday knot class for new crew
listings.summary: Bowline, clove hitch, and a coil that will not explode in the locker. Free, 11:00, bring a length of old line if you have it.

listings.title: Oyster bags to sort, short shift
listings.summary: Four hours on the trestles, low tide window. Waterproofs on the hook. Cash same day.

listings.title: Green lamp out on the east groyne
listings.summary: Unlit since Monday night. Use the red on the pier head until it is replaced. Report is already with Trinity.

listings.title: Pollock stew at the watch house
listings.summary: Wednesday, 18:30. Bowl and bread, pay what you can. First come; forty covers.

listings.title: Front due Thursday, southwest 6 to 7
listings.summary: Double up lines. Fenders on the pile side. The inner pontoon will surge after 15:00.
